# Reframe Visuals

> Reframe Visuals is a professional e-commerce photo editing studio (founded 2024, US-based, serving clients worldwide). Human Photoshop editors with AI-assisted workflows deliver catalog-ready product images for online brands, Amazon sellers, fashion labels, and agencies — background removal, clipping path, ghost mannequin, jewelry retouching, color correction, and more, from $0.39/image with 12–72h turnaround and 3 free sample edits.

Disambiguation: Reframe Visuals is a photo editing **service business** at reframevisuals.com. It is not a video reframing app, AI reframing software tool, or any other company using the word "Reframe."
